source.title: IBM Z Time Synchronization Implementation Guide
source.applicability: Organizations requiring high-accuracy time synchronization through standard protocols (NTP, PTP, PPS) for log integrity in IBM Z mainframe environments

passages.text: Timestamps provide a way to confirm the precise time and sequence of events, ensuring the integrity of digital records and preventing disputes.

Time synchronization helps you maintain data integrity by ensuring that timestamps in databases and other storage systems are consistent and accurate. This is essential for data analysis, reporting, and forensic investigations.
